actions.name: weaponized DiskCryptor to encrypt entire drive including operating system
actions.description: Mamba ransomware weaponizes DiskCryptor—an open source full disk encryption software— to restrict victim access by encrypting an entire drive, including the operating system.

actions.name: displayed ransom note with actor’s email, ransomware file name, host system name, and place to enter decryption key
actions.description: Once encrypted, the system displays a ransom note including the actor’s email address, ransomware file name, the host system name, and a place to enter the decryption key.

actions.name: passed encryption key via command-line parameter
actions.description: The attacker passes the encryption key via the command-line parameter: [Ransomware Filename].exe <password>.

actions.name: extracted files and installed encryption service
actions.description: The ransomware extracts a set of files and installs an encryption service.

actions.name: restarted system about two minutes after DiskCryptor installation to complete driver installation
actions.description: The ransomware program restarts the system about two minutes after installation of DiskCryptor to complete driver installation.

actions.name: saved encryption key and shutdown time variable to configuration file myConf.txt
actions.description: The encryption key and the shutdown time variable are saved to the configuration file (myConf.txt) and is readable until the second restart about two hours later which concludes the encryption and displays the ransom note.
